title: ServeSmart Portal
shortDescription: Smart Service Provider Recommendation System connecting users with local service professionals.
fullDescription: ServeSmart is a full-stack platform that helps users find and hire verified local service providers in Colombo. Features include real-time service matching, location-based searching, and user rating systems.

title: Mise POS System
shortDescription: A sleek React-based Point of Sale application featuring product inventory management, stock monitoring, and real-time order processing.
fullDescription: Mise POS is a modern Web-based Point of Sale system built with React to streamline billing and order management. It features product catalog management, stock status filtering (In stock / Low stock), and an intuitive cart interface for seamless cashier order processing with automatic subtotal and discount calculations.

title: Coffee Shop Management System
shortDescription: A desktop-based coffee shop management system built with Java (OOP) and MySQL to streamline order processing, menu management, and inventory tracking.
fullDescription: Cuppa Bliss ERP is a comprehensive desktop-based coffee shop management system built with Java (OOP) and MySQL. It provides seamless order processing, menu management, and inventory tracking capabilities for modern coffee shop chains.

title: Laravel CRUD Management System
shortDescription: A robust CRUD application built with Laravel and MySQL for managing dynamic data and user records.
fullDescription: A full-featured web application built using the Laravel framework following the MVC pattern. It enables seamless Create, Read, Update, and Delete (CRUD) operations with database management, dynamic forms, and structured routing.

title: Yakunex Portfolio
shortDescription: A high-performance corporate portfolio website featuring rich interactive UI elements and responsive layouts.
fullDescription: Official corporate web platform designed for Yakunex Technologies to highlight agency services, modern product portfolio, and contact workflows.

title: AirGuard IoT System
shortDescription: An autonomous fire and gas alerting system utilizing ESP32, MQ-2, LM35 sensors, and visual LCD notifications.
fullDescription: Smart IoT hardware prototype that monitors ambient temperature, hazardous gas concentration, and sends real-time alerting signals.
